intended_object: An auxiliary fresh "dummy" variable for alpha-renaming in a machine-generated nominal proof certificate. It is the variable `freshVar (fv(cv(alphaDummy003 A)) ∪ fv(cv(alphaDummy000 A))) 1`. I inferred this from the name `alphaDummy047`, the docstring ("checked nominal proof certificate identified upstream as `alpha_dummy_047`") and the surrounding file, whose definitions are all of this kind.
explanation: This is not a mathematical object. The definition only picks a fresh variable, one that avoids the free variables of two other dummy variables, so that alpha-renaming steps work inside an automatically generated proof replay for the NF weak-partition development. It belongs to a numbered family of such helpers (`alphaDummy000`, `alphaDummy001`, …), and the definition of `alphaDummy000` reads `freshVar A.fv 0`. The choice is an implementation detail with no counterpart in the literature, and Mathlib has nothing comparable.
